scenarios.title_zh: CBP 查验扣货（NII / 尾门 / CET）
scenarios.summary_zh: 货物到港后被 CBP 布控查验，可能是扫描、尾门开箱或 CET 深度查验，客户催进度并担心罚款或错过销售档期。
customer_signals: Why is my container still at customs? It's been six days.
海关查验一般要几天？客户天天催，我顶不住了
Is my cargo going to be fined because of this?

empathy: 先接住客户「货在港口却动不了」的无力感，点明查验直接冲击他的补货或上架节奏
不要把「这是 CBP 的决定」当开场白，那会让客户觉得你在撇清
facts: CBP 可在到港后布控查验：NII（非侵入式扫描/X 光）约 1–3 个工作日、CET（反走私执法组）3–7 个工作日、送 CES 的 intensive exam 7–21 个工作日（经验值，旺季更久）
查验是边境监管动作，不等于申报有问题，也不自动产生罚款；是否补税要看查验结论
若需拖至 CES（集中查验站），会产生拖车、站台排队和额外时间
plan: 向报关行确认查验类型、CES 位置、是否已排期，拿到 CBP 查验通知编号
提前备好发票、装箱单、品名用途说明，避免因资料不全二次查验
放行后 24 小时内锁定派送，FBA 货优先重约入仓
sync: 2 小时内首次回复；查验期间每 24 小时主动同步一次
状态变化（转深度查验或放行）当天告知，不等客户追问
reassure: 明确由同一名 owner 跟到底，不换人、不把客户晾着
给可执行备选：延迟函、分批派送、改送海外仓

scripts.use_when: 客户第一次问查验进度，情绪尚可控
scripts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, I know a customs hold is the last thing you need right now — I'd be watching the clock too.

I've checked with our customs broker this morning. Your shipment is at {{port}} and CBP (U.S. Customs and Border Protection) has pulled it for an exam. It's an NII (non-intrusive inspection) scan rather than a full tailgate or CET (Contraband Enforcement Team) inspection, which is the lightest of the three. An exam is a border check, not a finding against your shipment.

Our broker has confirmed the exam slot and the drayage, and we're holding a delivery slot for release day. I won't give you a date I can't stand behind.

I'll message you by {{next_update_time}}, sooner if the status moves. I'm staying on this personally.

scripts.use_when: 已回复过一次，客户再次追问；或查验无进展需主动同步
scripts.text:
Quick update on your shipment at {{port}}: the NII (non-intrusive inspection) scan is done, but CBP has moved it to a tailgate inspection, which adds time. Our broker has it booked into the exam station for tomorrow morning and has sent the invoice and packing list they asked for.

Nothing points to a compliance problem — this is still a routine exam. I'll come back to you by {{next_update_time}} with the result.

scripts.use_when: 查验放行后说明结果，或客户情绪升级需要主管出面
scripts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, your shipment cleared CBP this afternoon. No penalty was raised and nothing additional was assessed at release. We've released it to the drayage carrier and booked delivery for {{delivery_date}}; you'll get the driver's window the day before.

I'm sorry this exam cost you the week you'd planned. The port was running a heavier exam queue than usual, and I'd rather say that plainly than dress it up.

If anything else comes up on this shipment, message me directly. I'll keep owning it until it's signed for.

alts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, I'm sorry — I know this hold is eating into your launch window, and that's genuinely stressful when you've already paid for the stock.

I've just been through the file with our broker. Your shipment is at {{port}} and CBP has selected it for an exam. What we can see so far is a non-intrusive scan rather than a full inspection, which usually moves faster. It's a routine border check; it doesn't mean CBP has found a problem with your declaration.

Our broker is chasing the exam station and we've pre-booked the drayage so it moves the moment it's released. I'll update you by {{next_update_time}}, and if it escalates you'll hear it from me the same day.

Hi {{customer_name}} — status on your shipment: it's at {{port}} and CBP has flagged it for an exam. It's currently a scan-level exam, not a full inspection, and there's no indication of a declaration problem.

Our broker has the exam slot booked and drayage on standby, so we move as soon as CBP releases it. I can't give you a release date yet; I can give you a real update by {{next_update_time}}.

If you need to brief your own customer, I can send a one-paragraph note you can forward.

common_causes: CBP 风险布控或随机抽检
同柜其他货主触发查验导致整柜滞留
申报要素与实物不符（品名、用途、型号）
PGA 关注品类被一并转查
resolution_path: 确认查验类型与 CES 位置，登记 CBP 查验通知编号
报关行预约查验并安排拖车与站台
按 CBP Form 28 要求补资料，跟踪查验结论
放行后缴税提柜，24 小时内安排派送
超 5 个工作日未排期，升级报关行主管与港口 CBP 联络人
internal.sla_hint: 首次响应 2 小时内；查验期间每 24 小时主动同步；放行后 24 小时内给派送计划；超 5 个工作日升级主管
internal.fee_policy: DDP 项下 CBP 查验本身不收费，但 CES 站台费、拖车费、柜租等常规查验配套费用由我方承担；因客户资料错误、拒收或改址导致的滞箱与仓储，先书面确认再收。
guardrails: 不承诺具体放行日期，只给区间与前置条件
不暗示查验是 CBP 针对客户，不评价执法
不建议拆单、改品名或换编码来规避查验

scenarios.title_en: ISF filed late — possible liquidated damages
scenarios.summary_zh: ISF 未在装船前 24 小时申报，客户担心被 CBP 罚款或扣货；需要补报、确认 bond 并管理罚金风险。
customer_signals: ISF was late? Nobody told me. Am I getting a penalty?
ISF 漏报了，会不会被海关罚钱？
My broker says CBP may fine us. How bad is it?

empathy: 客户听到「罚金」会恐慌，先接住「会不会被罚、会不会扣货」的担心
不回避迟报事实，但把「迟报」与「违法、罚金」分开讲
facts: ISF（Importer Security Filing，10+2）须在装船前 24 小时传输，迟报或错报属申报合规问题
CBP 可发 liquidated damages，金额视情节，不能报死数字；也可能只要求补正
ISF 不是 entry summary，补报或更正后通常不阻断清关，但可能被 CBP 标记
plan: 调取 ISF 传输时间戳与报文，核对 10 项数据
当日提交 amendment，确认 ISF bond 有效，无 bond 立即补
与船司、报关行确认是否已被 CBP 标记，必要时准备书面说明
sync: 2 小时内回复；当日给 filing receipt
每日查一次 entry 直到放行，罚金通知第一时间转客户
reassure: 罚金通知来了先由我方复核再谈付款，不让客户单独应对
不承诺「一定不罚」，承诺第一手处理与完整记录

scripts.use_when: 客户第一次得知 ISF 迟报，担心罚款
scripts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, I understand why this has you worried — an ISF issue sounds serious, and the word penalty doesn't help.

Here's what I've confirmed. ISF (Importer Security Filing, also called 10+2) has to be transmitted 24 hours before the cargo is loaded at the origin port. For {{bill_no}}, the filing went in late against that clock. That's a compliance problem with the filing, not a seizure, and it doesn't automatically mean a fine. CBP can issue liquidated damages, but the amount depends on the facts and I won't quote a number I don't have.

Our broker is amending the ISF today, confirming the bond is active, and checking whether CBP has flagged the container at {{port}}. You'll have the filing receipt by {{next_update_time}}.

I'll stay on it and update you even if there's nothing new.

scripts.use_when: 补报已提交，客户追问是否还会被罚
scripts.text:
Update on {{bill_no}}: the amended ISF was accepted this morning, and our broker has the transmission timestamp on file. CBP has not issued a penalty notice so far, and the container at {{port}} is still moving through normal clearance.

I've asked the broker to check the entry daily until it releases. Next update from me by {{next_update_time}}.

scripts.use_when: 放行且无罚金通知，说明整改动作
scripts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, good news on {{bill_no}} — CBP released the shipment without a liquidated damages claim. The late ISF is closed out, and the amended filing is the record going forward.

We've changed the handoff on our desk so the ISF clock is checked at booking, not at documentation. That one was ours to fix, not yours.

Delivery is still tracking for {{delivery_date}}. If CBP sends anything later, forward it to me and I'll handle the response directly.

alts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, I can hear the worry in your message, and I don't blame you — ISF penalty is a scary phrase when you're the one exposed.

I've checked the file myself. The ISF for {{bill_no}} went in after the 24-hour pre-loading cut-off, so it's late. But a late filing is not a violation finding: CBP has not issued anything against you, and the container is still at {{port}} awaiting normal clearance. If CBP does raise liquidated damages, the figure is case-specific and we'll review it before anyone pays.

Our broker is amending the filing and confirming the bond today. I'll send you the acceptance receipt by {{next_update_time}} and keep checking the entry daily until it's released.

Hi {{customer_name}} — on {{bill_no}}: the ISF was filed after the 24-hour pre-loading deadline, so it's late. No penalty notice has been issued, and the container is still in normal clearance at {{port}}.

Our broker is amending the filing now and confirming the bond. You'll have the acceptance receipt by {{next_update_time}}, and I'm checking the entry daily until release.

If CBP raises liquidated damages, send me the notice and we'll review it together before responding. If a notice lands in your inbox before I write again, forward it straight away.

common_causes: 订舱信息晚于截单时间才到，ISF 没有留出 24 小时
收货人、工厂地址或 HS 编码变更后未同步更新 ISF
ISF bond 未生效或额度不足，报文被拒
客户指定货代与起运港代理之间信息断点
resolution_path: 调取 ISF 传输时间戳、报文与 CBP 回执，确认迟报节点
当日提交 amendment，核对 10 项数据与 ISF bond 状态
确认 CBP 是否已标记或发出 CF 28/29、罚金通知
如收到 liquidated damages 通知，先复核事实与金额（19 CFR 149 下量级约 US$5,000/次，对外不报死数）再决定是否申诉
结案后把 ISF 检查前置到订舱环节，更新 SOP
internal.sla_hint: 2 小时内首次回复；当日给 filing receipt；每日查 entry 至放行；罚金通知 24 小时内给出处理意见
internal.fee_policy: ISF 申报费含在 DDP 报价内；因客户提供信息错误导致的改单费按成本收；liquidated damages 在责任厘清前不向客户收取，凭 CBP 通知与证据协商。
guardrails: 不报具体罚金金额，只说视情节并由 CBP 决定
不建议倒签时间戳、补虚假数据或隐瞒迟报
不把迟报责任直接推给客户或船司

scenarios.title_zh: 美国关税争议（301 / IEEPA / de minimis）
scenarios.title_en: Disputed duty on a DDP shipment
scenarios.summary_zh: DDP 报价后客户又收到补税账单，涉及 Section 301、IEEPA 关税变化与 de minimis 暂停，客户质疑重复收费或要求退税。
customer_signals: DDP 说好含税的，为什么又给我一张税单？
Why is the duty higher than what you quoted?
I heard the IEEPA tariffs were struck down. Can I get a refund?

empathy: 客户觉得 DDP 报价被「加价」，先承认这种被背刺感，再解释税与运费的区别
不拿「政策变了」当挡箭牌，先给可核对的税单文件
facts: 美国关税税基以成交价格为基础，通常不含国际运保费（与澳、加相反）；另计 MPF（约 0.3464%）与 HMF（0.125%），费率按财年调整
税率栈＝基础 HTS＋Section 301（对华）＋Section 232（钢铝铜、汽车、半导体等）；2026-02-20 最高法院推翻 IEEPA 关税后，2026-02-24 起另有 Section 122 临时附加税（10%，上限 15%、最长 150 天，以 CBP CSMS 为准）
de minimis 自 2025-08-29 全面暂停且 Type 86 停用；2026-06-24 起无限期写入 19 CFR 10.151，法定终止日 2027-07-01。IEEPA 退税走 CAPE，仅限含 IEEPA 行的 entry，一般 60–90 天
DDP 通常锁定报价时税率；美国法定纳税义务人始终是 IOR，DDP 不改变该义务，商业分担看合同条款
plan: 调 7501 entry summary，逐行列 HTS、税率、Chapter 99 附加税与计税依据
核对是否含 IEEPA 行（可走 CAPE）、301 exclusion 是否仍在有效窗口
区分法定税率变化、归类错误、我方申报错误，按合同定承担
属我方错误的主动 PSC 更正并承担；属法定变化的书面说明并给未来报价
sync: 2 个工作日内给完整税单拆解；每周一次书面进展
CAPE 退税类按月同步，收到 CBP 通知当天转客户
reassure: 承诺「先给账、再谈钱」，不先收费后解释
不承诺退税金额或到账日；CBP CAPE 一般 60–90 天，以最新公告为准

scripts.use_when: 客户收到补税账单，第一次提出异议
scripts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, I understand why the extra duty on {{bill_no}} feels like a bait-and-switch after a DDP quote. Let me walk you through it.

I've pulled the entry. The charge is duty, not freight: the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) rate, Section 301 duty, and any temporary surcharge on the entry date. Nothing here was billed under IEEPA (International Emergency Economic Powers Act), so the refund route CBP (U.S. Customs and Border Protection) opened for them doesn't apply. Rates moved repeatedly since 2025; your DDP rate covers the rate we quoted, not a later statutory change — whether this lands with you depends on the terms we signed, which I'm checking.

By {{next_update_time}} you'll have the 7501, the HTS code, and a one-page breakdown. If any part is refundable, I'll pursue it and credit what comes back.

I won't ask you to accept a number I can't explain.

scripts.use_when: 税单拆解已出，客户仍在追问能否少付或退税
scripts.text:
On {{bill_no}}: the breakdown is done. The Section 301 line is the big one and it was correctly applied; the base duty matches the HTS code. One possible angle is an exclusion — our broker is checking whether any of your lines are covered, and the exclusion lists have changed repeatedly, so we'll confirm the current position rather than rely on a date.

I'll give you a clear yes or no by {{next_update_time}}.

scripts.use_when: 确认无多收，给未来报价方案
scripts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, here's where we landed on {{bill_no}}: the duty charged matches the HTS code and the rates in force when the entry was filed, so there's no overcharge to recover. The Section 301 line is the bulk of it, and that's a tariff, not a fee I can waive.

What I can do is quote your next shipment with today's rate stack built in, including the exclusion position, so there's no surprise at delivery. Our pricing desk is reworking the next PO now.

If you want the entry package for your records, say the word and I'll send it over.

alts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, I'm sorry — getting a duty bill after a DDP quote is genuinely unsettling, and you have every right to push back on it.

I've gone through {{bill_no}} line by line. What you're seeing is duty, not freight: the base HTS rate plus Section 301 duty in force when the entry was filed. This entry carries no IEEPA (International Emergency Economic Powers Act) line, so CBP (U.S. Customs and Border Protection) can't process a refund for those duties here. That's not the answer you were hoping for, but I'd rather give you the real one.

I'll send the full breakdown, including the 7501 and the HTS code, by {{next_update_time}}. If an exclusion or a correction applies, I'll chase it and pass back whatever CBP returns.

Hi {{customer_name}} — on {{bill_no}}, I've pulled the entry. The charge is duty: base HTS rate plus Section 301 duty applied on the entry date. There's no IEEPA (International Emergency Economic Powers Act) line here, so the CAPE (Consolidated Administration and Processing of Entries) refund route doesn't apply.

One change worth knowing: since 29 August 2025 the US$800 de minimis exemption has been suspended for all countries, so low-value shipments are entered and dutied too; the statutory end date is 1 July 2027.

I'm sending the 7501 and a one-page breakdown by {{next_update_time}}; if an exclusion applies to any of your codes, I'll flag it and pursue it.

common_causes: DDP 报价后法定税率调整（301、232、IEEPA 变化）
HTS 归类与客户预期不一致导致税基变化
客户把关税当成运费或附加费
de minimis 暂停后低值货也要缴税，客户不知情
Section 122 临时附加税与 301 叠加，客户以为是重复收费
resolution_path: 调 7501，逐行列 HTS、税率、Chapter 99 附加税与计税依据
核对是否含 IEEPA 行（可走 CAPE）与 301 exclusion 现行有效期（以 USTR 当期公告为准，不对客报具体到期日）
区分法定税率变化、归类错误、我方申报错误，按合同定承担
属我方错误的主动 PSC 并承担；属法定变化的书面说明并给未来报价
符合 CAPE 条件的 entry，协助 IOR 提交退税申请并跟踪
internal.sla_hint: 2 个工作日内给完整税单拆解；每周一次书面进展；CAPE 退税按 CBP 受理节奏每月同步
internal.fee_policy: DDP 报价锁定报价时的税率与归类；美国法定纳税义务人是 IOR，DDP 不改变该义务，商业分担以合同条款为准并书面确认；我方申报错误导致的补税与利息由我方承担；退税到账后按合同约定返还。
guardrails: 不承诺退税金额或到账日（CBP CAPE 一般 60–90 天，以公告为准）
不建议低报货值、改 HS、拆单或改发票
不把税率变化说成「海关乱收费」

scenarios.summary_zh: CBP 认为申报的 HTS 编码不正确，发 Form 28/29 要求说明，可能补税并影响后续清关，客户担心成本失控。
customer_signals: CBP changed the HTS code — does that mean I owe more?
海关说我们归类错了，要补多少税？
Why is my product classified under a different code?

empathy: 归类争议客户最怕「补税加罚金」，先把技术分歧与欺诈指控分开
承认改归类会打乱成本模型，先帮客户算清敞口
facts: HTS 10 位归类由 CBP 最终认定；归类错误可能导致补税与利息，情节严重才涉及 19 U.S.C. § 1592 罚则
CBP 常用 Form 28（要求资料）与 Form 29（拟采取措施），有答复期限，逾期可能被视为接受
可查 CROSS 先例，也可申请 binding ruling 锁定未来归类
plan: 收集产品规格、材质、功能、加工工艺与同类判例，形成归类备忘录
在 CBP 期限内书面答复；确认申报错误则评估 PSC 主动更正与抗辩的利弊
与客户书面确认补税承担口径后再提交，避免先斩后奏
sync: 24 小时内出内部初判；CBP 期限前 3 天给客户定稿
每周同步进展，CBP 有新文书当天转客户
reassure: 承诺不擅自改 HS、不为降税换编码；我方错误按合同承担
给客户最好与最坏两套成本情景，帮他做商业决策

scripts.use_when: 客户收到 CBP 归类质疑或 Form 28/29
scripts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, I know a reclassification notice feels like the ground moving under you — especially when you've already priced the goods and sold them.

I've read the CBP notice on {{bill_no}}. CBP is proposing a different HTS (Harmonized Tariff Schedule) subheading than the one we declared, which would change the duty rate. This is a classification question, not an accusation of fraud, and it isn't final yet — we have a window to respond with the product specification, materials, and function.

Our broker is pulling the full technical file today and comparing it against CBP's reasoning and published rulings in CROSS (Customs Rulings Online Search System). If the facts support our original code, we'll respond with evidence; if CBP is right, I'll tell you straight and model the cost before you decide on a post-summary correction.

I'll have a written position for you by {{next_update_time}}.

scripts.use_when: 需要客户补产品资料，或答复期限临近
scripts.text:
On your shipment: our broker has finished the first pass. The key question is the primary function of the unit, and the spec sheet we have is thin on that point. I've asked your team for the product manual and a materials breakdown — that's the evidence that decides this.

No change to the entry yet. I'll update you by {{next_update_time}}.

scripts.use_when: 答复已提交或 CBP 已裁定，向客户交代结果
scripts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, we've filed our response on your shipment with the technical file attached, keeping the original HTS code. CBP hasn't accepted it yet, so I won't call it won.

If CBP confirms the change, the additional duty would be {{amount}} plus interest, and I'll show you that calculation before anything is billed. If they accept our position, the entry stands as filed.

Either way, you'll hear from me by {{next_update_time}}, and I'll send the ruling reference for your records once it's closed.

alts.text:
Hi {{customer_name}}, a reclassification notice is unsettling — I get it, especially when you've already sold the goods at a price built on the old code.

I've read the CBP notice on {{bill_no}} myself. CBP is proposing a different HTS subheading, which would change the duty rate. That's a technical disagreement, not an accusation, and it isn't final: we have a window to respond with the product specification, materials and primary function.

Our broker is building that file now and checking CROSS (Customs Rulings Online Search System) for rulings on comparable goods. If the evidence supports our original code, we'll fight for it; if CBP is right, I'll tell you straight and model the cost before you decide anything.

You'll have my written position by {{next_update_time}}.

Hi {{customer_name}} — CBP has proposed a different HTS code for the goods on {{bill_no}}, which would raise the duty rate. It's not final, and we have a response window.

Our broker is pulling the spec, materials and function evidence today and checking comparable CBP rulings in CROSS (Customs Rulings Online Search System). 与客户书面确认承担口径后再提交

internal.sla_hint: 24 小时内出内部初判；CBP 答复期限前 3 天给客户定稿；每周同步进展

guardrails: 不为降税建议改 HS 或模糊申报

scenarios.title_zh: PGA 扣留（FDA / FCC / CPSC / USDA）
scenarios.title_en: Shipment held by a Partner Government Agency
scenarios.summary_zh: CBP 将货物转交 FDA、FCC、CPSC 或 USDA 审核，PGA 未放行导致货物滞留，客户不清楚缺什么资料。
customer_signals: FDA hold? It's just skincare — why is it stuck?
海关说要 FDA 资料，到底要补什么？
CPSC has our shipment. How long is this going to take?

empathy: 客户常误以为「被海关扣了」，先解释是另一家机构在审，减少对 CBP 的误解
承认等待期无法承诺，但可以让客户知道卡在哪、缺什么
facts: PGA 指 FDA、FCC、CPSC、USDA APHIS 等；CBP 负责转办，放行权在 PGA
FDA 食品需 prior notice 与设施注册；FCC 射频设备需设备授权；CPSC 儿童产品需 CPC、其他受规则约束的消费品需 GCC，2026-07-08 起强制 eFiling；USDA 植物动物产品需许可证与检疫。PGA 审查时长以通知为准，不对客报固定天数
PGA 会发 May Proceed、Intensive Exam、Detention 等不同消息，处理路径不同
plan: 先拿 PGA 消息类型与 reason code，确认是资料问题还是实质合规问题
按机构清单一次性补齐注册号、检测报告、CPC、FCC ID、许可证，避免挤牙膏式补件

sync: 2 小时内回复；24 小时内给资料清单
每日跟进 PGA 状态；每周一次书面汇总
reassure: 不承诺 PGA 放行日；承诺专人盯、补件一次到位、退运方案提前备
涉及召回或违规，第一时间升级主管与合规，不自行承诺

scenarios.title_zh: 洛杉矶/长滩拥堵与 IPI 铁路延误
scenarios.title_en: Port congestion and IPI rail delay
scenarios.summary_zh: 船期跳港、泊位排队、码头拥堵或 IPI 铁路舱位紧张导致 ETA 反复，客户无法向自己的客户交代。
customer_signals: The ETA moved again. What is actually happening?
船又晚了一周，到底什么时候能到？
Is my cargo stuck on the water or on the rail?

empathy: ETA 反复最伤客户信任，先承认「每次改期都像又一次失约」
不拿船司或铁路当挡箭牌，先给最新可核实节点
facts: 洛杉矶/长滩的泊位排队、底盘车短缺会拖慢 gate-out；IPI 铁路舱位紧张会拖内陆段
船司 ETA 是估计值，实际以靠泊、卸船、铁路装车为准
跳港或改挂会改变入境口岸，可能触发 entry 改单与额外拖车
plan: 每日抓船司、码头、铁路三个节点，形成时间轴给客户
提前锁 drayage 与铁路舱位，评估卡车直达或改港备选
影响 FBA 或促销档期时，给最晚可到日与替代方案
sync: 每 48 小时常规更新；ETA 变化当天通知
每周一次书面时间轴，标出承诺与实际
reassure: 不承诺 ETA；承诺变动第一时间告知，备选方案先报价再执行
超两周延误升级主管，评估运费或仓储减免

scripts.use_when: 客户第一次追问 ETA 变化

I'll update you by {{next_update_time}}, and any ETA change reaches you the same day.

I'm holding a drayage slot and checking the next rail window daily. I'll come back to you by {{next_update_time}} with a firmer inland date.

scenarios.title_zh: Demurrage / Detention / Storage 费用争议
scenarios.summary_zh: 货物在码头或设备超期产生 demurrage、detention、storage，客户认为不是自己的责任，拒绝承担。
customer_signals: Who pays for demurrage? This isn't my fault.
滞箱费为什么这么高？我又没让他压港
I'm not paying storage because your truck was late.

empathy: 滞箱费最易激化，因为客户觉得「货没到手先被罚钱」，先接住不公平感
不先谈钱，先把计费起止点与责任归属摆出来
facts: demurrage 是集装箱在码头超过 free time；detention 是提离码头后超期占用设备，两者分开计费
计费以码头或船司系统时间为准，预约取消、缺 appointment、无人收货都会让时钟继续走
FMC 46 CFR Part 541 要求 D&D 发票信息准确充分、开票期限 30 天，不符者可主张无付款义务；541.4 已于 2025-09-23 被撤销，其余条款仍有效
plan: 拉 free time、gate-out、appointment、terminal 记录，做一张计费时间轴
区分我方原因、终端原因、客户原因，分别走承担、争议、书面确认
先止费（提柜、还柜、改约），再谈减免；争议附证据在 5 个工作日内提交
sync: 当天给费用预估；每日同步计费变化
争议 5 个工作日内立案；每周一次书面进展
reassure: 不承诺减免；承诺不静默计费、账单先拆解再收
我方责任的费用直接认，不转嫁；客户原因的先书面确认再收

scripts.use_when: 客户第一次收到滞箱费账单并提出异议

I'll update you by {{next_update_time}} with what's been waived and what hasn't.

地址问题不指责客户，先说解决办法

scenarios.title_zh: 少箱 / 短装 / 丢件

customer_signals: Three cartons are missing — the warehouse says they never arrived.
少了 3 箱，仓库说没收到

empathy: 少货比破损更难接受，因为不知道去哪了，先承认这种不确定感

I'll have an initial finding for you by {{next_update_time}}.

我已经催了三次了，你们到底有没有人管？

customer_signals: FBA appointment failed again — Amazon is charging me.
FBA 预约又失败了，亚马逊要收我钱
The FC rejected my pallets. What now?

plan: 核对 shipment ID、FNSKU、箱数、托盘规格与 appointment
重新贴标或换托盘，承运人改约，必要时改送海外仓中转
评估 drop-trailer 或 floor load 等选项与费用
sync: 2 小时内回复；24–48 小时内给新预约
派送前 24 小时确认；每周汇总一次
reassure: 不承诺拿到某个时段，承诺预约确认才发车
费用先报后收；如 FC 原因导致，协助申诉
